title: Pencil vs Hiring an AI Creative Agency: Cost per Finished Ad
summary: Pencil vs hiring an AI creative agency: compare Pencil plans with agency batches from Knowlify, Admiral Media, Vidful and Creatify Studio per finished ad.
body_markdown:
## Which hire model fits your team?


### Knowlify: our top pick when you need finished ads every week


Knowlify (YC S25, founded 2025, based in San Francisco) is the best fit when the reason you are weighing Pencil is that nobody on your team has time to make and approve the ads, because we hand you about 25 finished ads a week instead of a generation allowance. The first batch lands on day five, and a person checks every ad before delivery, so your staff time goes to briefing and approving rather than editing. You can buy creative only or add end-to-end Meta campaign management.


The three formats are AI UGC (AI presenters talking to camera), 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. Pricing is a custom quote, so ask for one that states the ad count. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the site, linked from our[pricing and guarantee section](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ).


**Best for:** teams that need a steady flow of finished ads without an editor on staff.


**When to pick another option:** you want software your own team controls, or you need real human creators on camera.


### Admiral Media: fixed batches with separate management


Admiral Media's[AI creative agency page](https://admiral.media/ai-creative-agency/) describes AI creative batches with human review. Its published example is a batch of 10,000 euros for 20 ads up to 15 seconds, with media and management separate, checked October 13, 2026.


**Best for:** game and app advertisers that want fixed batches and already know how many ads they need.


### CreatStrat: a monthly subscription for Meta-first brands


CreatStrat's[homepage](https://creatstrat.com/) prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly and cancellable anytime. Its formats include statics, carousels, footage mashups, AI video and AI UGC, and it is built for DTC brands on Meta. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad.


**Best for:** small DTC brands that want a predictable weekly count on a low monthly budget.


### Adguns: weekly concepts for multi-market teams


Adguns'[weekly creatives page](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) describes 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes a week, from 1,000 euros a month, with monthly review and no long-term lock-in. It describes production as AI-assisted and human-curated. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included, and the first batch typically ships within two weeks of kickoff.


**Best for:** multi-market teams that already have a buyer and want weekly static and video concepts.


## When is Pencil the better buy?


Pencil is the better buy when your team already has an editor and a brand system, and wants to make variations in-house. It also fits when your volume is steady enough that a 50 or 250 generation allowance covers the work. If you want the software and its scores more than a finished service, Pencil is the direct choice. Our[performance creative agency guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/performance-creative-agency) explains how to brief and evaluate a team like the agencies here.


Legal terms can matter too. Pencil's pricing page lists enterprise terms of service, including IP assignment, "no train" and indemnification, for its Pro tier only, and that tier is custom priced. Core and Growth are listed with standard terms, so get the terms in writing before you rely on them.


## What should you check before you sign?


Claim checks stay with you whichever route you choose. The FTC's advertising guidance says advertisers need evidence for their claims, and a tool is not evidence that an ad's claims are true. Assign that responsibility in the brief, regardless of whether a generator or an agency makes the ad, using the[FTC's advertising FAQs for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/advertising-faqs-guide-small-business) .


AI labels also apply to both routes. Meta says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI features, and that it will begin automatically detecting ads made with third-party AI tools and showing an "AI info" label in About this ad; the post does not say that detection is live yet. Check the current rules before launch, using[Meta's AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) .


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick when you hire: about 25 finished AI video ads a week, each checked by a person, from $5,000 a month.
- Pencil is cheaper on plan price, starting at $14 a month, but its generations are not finished ads.
- Compare cost per finished, approved ad, and include the staff time to brief and approve each one.
- Keep claim checks and AI labels in the brief whichever route you choose.


## FAQ


### Is Pencil cheaper than hiring an agency?


On plan price, yes: Core costs $14 a month billed monthly. On cost per finished ad, the answer depends on how many approved ads your team produces. Count the staff time to brief, generate, edit and approve each ad, because that cost does not appear on Pencil's pricing page.


### What does Knowlify cost per ad?


Knowlify does not publish a per-ad price. Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. Ask for a quote that states the number of finished ads and the scope of any Meta management you want.


### Which published option has the lowest cost per ad?


Among the published numbers here, CreatStrat works out to about $12 to $15 per ad at 20 to 25 ads a month, which is our arithmetic. Vidful is about $58 per video, Admiral Media is 500 euros per ad, and Creatify Studio lists $100 to $200 per video. These are different units, so compare them against the ads you would actually run.


### Can a generation tool produce finished ads?


It can produce drafts. A finished ad still needs a hook, a claim check, captions, the right specs and a final approval. Pencil's plans describe generations and scores, and its creative team is part of a custom-priced tier.
